Dialog.ThisWillDeleteCachedDlss:
This will delete cached DLSS, Streamline, and component staging files to free disk space.

Shaders, installed RenoDX addons, and version metadata are preserved.

These files will be re-downloaded automatically when needed.

Continue?
Dialog.ThisWillOverwriteYourCurrent: This will overwrite your current NVIDIA driver profile settings with the saved backup. This cannot be undone.
Dialog.ThisWillPermanentlyDeleteThe: This will permanently delete the NVIDIA DXCache and GLCache folders. This cannot be undone.\n\nAll games will need to rebuild their shader caches on next launch, which may cause brief stuttering or longer load times the first time. This can fix shader corruption, persistent stuttering, or graphical issues after driver updates.
Dialog.ThisWillRemoveAllPer: This will remove ALL per-game NVIDIA driver profile overrides (DLSS/Streamline versions, presets, render scales, ReBAR, VSync, Smooth Motion, Low Latency, Power Mode — everything) AND reset global settings (Shader Cache, G-Sync, Refresh Rate, ReBAR) to defaults.\n\nAll profiles will return to NVIDIA factory defaults. This cannot be undone.
Dialog.UncheckedPresetsKeepTheirExisting: Unchecked presets keep their existing per-preset values.

Xaml.AdjustDigitalVibranceColorSaturatio: Adjust Digital Vibrance (color saturation) per-display. Saved values are restored on app startup.
Xaml.AdjustNvidiaDigitalVibranceColor: Adjust NVIDIA Digital Vibrance (color saturation) per-display. Saved values are automatically restored on app startup.
Xaml.ArchiveUtilityUsedToExtract: Archive utility used to extract ReShade DLLs from the NSIS installer. 7z.exe and 7z.dll are bundled under the LGPL licence. Copyright © Igor Pavlov.
Xaml.AutoCompilesShadersInThe: Auto-compiles shaders in the background when idle. Higher = more CPU usage during idle, faster first-time game loads.
Xaml.AutomaticallyInstallReshadeRenodxRe: Automatically install ReShade, RenoDX, ReLimiter, DC, OptiScaler, RE Framework, Luma, DXVK and DOF Fix updates silently in the background
Xaml.AutomaticallySwapToTheNewest: Automatically swap to the newest version when a new release appears. Only affects games currently on the previous latest — manually chosen older versions are left alone.
Xaml.CheckAllComponentsAndThe: Check all components and the app for available updates
Xaml.ClearsAllCachesAndRe: Clears all caches and re-scans everything from disk. Use as a last resort if games are missing, paths have changed, DLSS has been added to a game, or the DLSS section is missing from a game card.
Xaml.ConfigurePreferredDlssStreamlineVer: Configure preferred DLSS/Streamline versions, presets, and render scales. Use 'Quick Apply' in the Nvidia Profile section to stamp these onto any game.
Xaml.ConfigureWhichPresetsReceiveThe: Configure which presets receive the global peak nits value.
Xaml.ControlHowRhiManagesShader: Control how RHI manages shader files across your games.
Xaml.ControlsGSyncFreesyncVariable: Controls G-Sync/FreeSync variable refresh rate. Fullscreen and Windowed recommended for seamless experience.
Xaml.ControlsHowShadersAreDisplayed: Controls how shaders are displayed in the ReShade overlay. Tabs groups effect files into named tabs; Tree shows a collapsible hierarchy.
Xaml.ControlsTheDlssTextOverlay: Controls the DLSS text overlay NVIDIA shows in the corner of games. Global system setting — affects all games. Requires admin.
Xaml.CreatesAScheduledTaskTo: Creates a scheduled task to launch RHI with elevated privileges. Required for ReBAR, Low Latency Ultra, and Smooth Motion driver settings. The Drop Helper enables Discord drag-and-drop when running elevated.
Xaml.CreatesAZipArchiveOf: Creates a zip archive of all logs and copies it to clipboard — paste directly into Discord
Xaml.CreatesNvidiaDriverProfilesFor: Creates NVIDIA driver profiles for all games that don't have one yet. Ensures global settings like Power Mode and VSync apply to every game.
Xaml.DeletesCachedDlssStreamlineAnd: Deletes cached DLSS, Streamline, and component staging files to free disk space. Shaders, installed addons, and version metadata are preserved. Files are re-downloaded automatically when needed.
Xaml.DeletesCachedDlssStreamlineAnd2: Deletes cached DLSS, Streamline, and download files to free disk space. Shaders are preserved.
Xaml.DeletesTheNvidiaDxcacheAnd: Deletes the NVIDIA DXCache and GLCache folders. Forces shaders to recompile on next launch.
Xaml.DeployDlssAndStreamlineDll: Deploy DLSS and Streamline DLL versions and DLSS presets to multiple games at once. Backs up originals automatically. Pre-populated with your configured defaults.
Xaml.DeployIniFilesOrReshade: Deploy INI files or ReShade presets to multiple games at once. Custom hotkey and screenshot path settings are preserved.
Xaml.DesktopResolutionToSwitchTo: Desktop resolution to switch to before a game launches. Restored on game exit.
Xaml.DirectxToVulkanTranslationLayer: DirectX-to-Vulkan translation layer for DX8/DX9/DX10 games. Includes Lilium HDR fork by EndlesslyFlowering for scRGB HDR output.
Xaml.DisableUpdateChecksForIndividual: Disable update checks for individual components. When disabled, the component will not be checked during startup or Update All.
Xaml.DriverLevelSettingsAppliedGlobally: Driver-level settings applied globally via the base NVIDIA profile. Per-game settings are in the Nvidia Profile section of each game's overrides panel.
Xaml.Dx11ModdingFrameworkAddingHdr: DX11 modding framework adding HDR support and graphics improvements via the ReShade addon system. Mods are downloaded from official GitHub releases. Drag-and-drop install with auto-detection, update checking, and per-game toggle.
Xaml.ExportSavesAllPerGame: Export saves all per-game NVIDIA driver settings to a backup file. Import restores them — useful before updating drivers.
Xaml.FetchesTheLatestManifestData: Fetches the latest manifest data and checks all components for available updates. Bypasses the 4-hour cooldown.
Xaml.FixesDepthOfFieldStepping: Fixes depth-of-field stepping and tiling artifacts in Unreal Engine 5 games.
Xaml.FrameRateLimiterAddonAvailable: Frame rate limiter addon available as an alternative to ReLimiter. The LITE variant is downloaded from GitHub on demand.
Xaml.GamesWithoutAnNvidiaProfile: Games without an NVIDIA profile don't benefit from global driver settings. Create profiles for all games in your library to ensure global settings apply.
Xaml.GlobalDmfgMaxFrameCount: Global DMFG max frame count. Games using Dynamic mode inherit this unless overridden per-game.
Xaml.GlobalDmfgTargetFrameRate: Global DMFG target frame rate. Off = no target. Max Refresh Rate = match display. Or pick a specific FPS.
Xaml.GlobalDynamicMultiFrameGeneration: Global Dynamic Multi Frame Generation defaults. Set these once — then just enable Dynamic mode on each game's MFG dialog.
Xaml.GlobalFpsCapViaNvidia: Global FPS cap via NVIDIA driver. VRR-optimal presets cap just below refresh rate to stay in VRR range.
Xaml.GlobalFpsCapWrittenTo: Global FPS cap written to all relimiter.ini files. Select a VRR preset or Custom for a manual value.
Xaml.GlobalPowerManagementModeApplies: Global power management mode — applies to all games without a per-game override.
Xaml.GlobalResizableBarEnablesLarge: Global Resizable BAR — enables large GPU memory transfers for all games. Requires admin and compatible hardware (RTX 30 Series+).
Xaml.GlobalVsyncModeAppliesTo: Global VSync mode — applies to all games without a per-game override.
Xaml.GloballyEnablesOrDisablesG: Globally enables or disables G-Sync/FreeSync variable refresh rate.
Xaml.GpuTypeDlssInputSettings: GPU type, DLSS input settings, and overlay hotkey for OptiScaler installations.
Xaml.HdrModFrameworkPowering800: HDR mod framework powering 800+ games. The entire reason this app exists.
Xaml.HdrModsInstallOneOr: ———  HDR Mods — Install one or both  ———
Xaml.HideThisGameFromThe: Hide this game from the sidebar (find it again in the Hidden filter)
Xaml.HighestAvailableForcesYourMax: Highest available forces your max refresh rate. App Setting lets games choose their own refresh rate.
Xaml.HtmlParserUsedToScrape: HTML parser used to scrape game data from the RenoDX wiki. Copyright © ZZZ Projects Inc.
Xaml.ManageGlobalShadersAndReshade: Manage global shaders and ReShade addons
Xaml.MaximumBarTransferSize1gb: Maximum BAR transfer size. 1GB is optimal for most games. Decrease to 512MB if experiencing ReBAR-related stutters.
Xaml.MaximumDiskSpaceForCompiled: Maximum disk space for compiled shader cache. Larger = fewer stutters on revisits. 16GB is the driver default.
Xaml.MinimizeToSystemTrayOn: Minimize to system tray on close. Right-click the tray icon or pinned taskbar icon to quickly launch recent games.
Xaml.ModdingFrameworkRequiredForReshade: Modding framework required for ReShade injection on RE Engine games. Downloaded from nightly builds on GitHub.
Xaml.MvvmHelpersObservableobjectRelaycom: MVVM helpers (ObservableObject, RelayCommand, etc.) used throughout the app. Copyright © .NET Foundation.
Xaml.NetWrapperForNvidiaS: .NET wrapper for NVIDIA's NvAPI used for all driver profile management — DLSS presets, render scale, ReBAR, VSync, Smooth Motion, and more.
Xaml.NewRenodxModsHaveBeen: New RenoDX mods have been added to the wiki
Xaml.NoRenodxModAvailableFor: No RenoDX mod available for this game
Xaml.OpenGameConfigFolderIn: Open game config folder in Explorer
Xaml.OpenTheScreenshotFolderIn: Open the screenshot folder in Explorer
Xaml.OpenUltraPageForThis: Open Ultra+ page for this game
Xaml.PasteYourNexusModsPersonal: Paste your Nexus Mods personal API key. Premium users get one-click downloads and silent auto-updates. Free users get one-click browser downloads.
Xaml.PeakBrightnessNitsWrittenTo: Peak brightness (nits) written to reshade.ini presets. HDR auto-toggle enables Windows HDR on game launch and disables on exit.
Xaml.PostProcessingInjectionFrameworkDow: Post-processing injection framework. Downloaded with full addon support from reshade.me and cached locally. Copyright © Crosire.
Xaml.ReadsYourMonitorSPeak: Reads your monitor's peak brightness automatically.
Xaml.RegisterRhiAsTheNxm: Register RHI as the nxm:// handler so Nexus "Mod Manager Download" buttons open directly in RHI.
Xaml.RelimiterOsdHotkeyAndGlobal: ReLimiter OSD hotkey and global feature settings applied to all games.
Xaml.RemovesAllPerGameNvidia: Removes ALL per-game NVIDIA profile overrides. The global profile will be like new.
Xaml.RescanGameLibraryAndFetch: Rescan game library and fetch latest mod info
Xaml.ReshadeAmpShaderPacksRenodx: ReShade & shader packs · RenoDX HDR mods · Luma Framework · DLSS/Streamline version swaps & presets · NVIDIA driver profile settings (VSync, Low Latency, ReBAR, Smooth Motion, Power) · OptiScaler · ReLimiter & Display Commander frame limiters · RE Framework · DXVK · UE-Extended native HDR · Per-game overrides for everything.
Xaml.ReshadeOptiscalerAndDlssStreamline: ⚠ ReShade, OptiScaler, and DLSS/Streamline modifications may trigger anti-cheat in online/multiplayer games
Xaml.RestorePerGameNvidiaProfile: Restore per-game NVIDIA profile settings from a previous export.
Xaml.RhiInstallsReshadeWithFull: RHI installs ReShade with full addon support, OptiScaler, and can swap DLSS/Streamline DLLs. These modifications may be flagged by anti-cheat in online or multiplayer games. Uninstall ReShade, OptiScaler, and restore DLSS/Streamline defaults before playing online.
Xaml.RhiManagedDeployBuiltIn:
RHI Managed: deploy built-in shader packs to all games.
Custom: use your own shader directory.
Off: RHI never touches shaders on any game.
Xaml.RhiWatchesThisFolderFor: RHI watches this folder for RenoDX addon files (.addon64/.addon32) and archives. Defaults to your Downloads folder.
Xaml.SaveAllPerGameNvidia: Save all per-game NVIDIA profile settings to a backup file.
Xaml.SaveCurrentSearchAsA: Save current search as a custom filter
Xaml.ScreenshotSavePathAndReshade: Screenshot save path and ReShade key bindings applied to all managed reshade.ini files.
Xaml.SelectTheTargetDesktopResolution: Select the target desktop resolution. Populated from your monitor's supported modes.
Xaml.SelectWhichMonitorsToChange: Select which monitors to change resolution on. Empty = primary display only.
Xaml.SelectWhichMonitorsToEnable: Select which monitors to enable HDR on. Empty = primary display only.
Xaml.ShowsDlssQualityModeRender: Shows DLSS quality mode, render resolution, and active features on the ReLimiter OSD. Disable if experiencing crashes.
Xaml.SomehowIHaveBecomeA: Somehow I have become a UI guy in multiple aspects of life lol.
Xaml.TheAllInOneGame: The all-in-one game enhancement toolkit for PC. Auto-detects games from 8 storefronts and provides one-click management for ReShade, HDR mods, shaders, DLSS/Streamline, frame limiters, NVIDIA driver profiles, and more — all from one place.
Xaml.TheDropHelperWindowEnables: The drop helper window enables Discord drag-and-drop in admin mode. Disable if you don't need it. Restart required.
Xaml.TheKeyThatTogglesThe: The key that toggles the ReLimiter OSD overlay in-game.
Xaml.ThisAppWouldNotExist: This app would not exist without the work of the following people and projects.
Xaml.ToggleBetweenDetailAndSimple: Toggle between Detail and Simple view
Xaml.TogglePerGameHdrAuto: Toggle per-game HDR auto-switch. Purple = HDR enabled on launch, disabled on exit.
Xaml.TogglePerGameResolutionSwitch: Toggle per-game resolution switch. Purple = resolution changes on launch, restores on exit.
Xaml.UnofficialCompanionAppNotAffiliated: Unofficial companion app. Not affiliated with RenoDX, Crosire, or pmnoxx.
Xaml.UpscalerRedirectionLayerEnablingDls: Upscaler redirection layer enabling DLSS, FSR, and XeSS across different GPU vendors. Downloaded from GitHub releases.
Xaml.WhenEnabledRhiSilentlyInstalls: When enabled, RHI silently installs component updates in the background after each update check. Games that are running when an update is detected will be retried automatically once they close. Does not apply to app updates.
Xaml.WhenOnAllGamesShare: When On, all games share the same OSD presets file. When Off, each game has its own presets.
Xaml.WhenOnAllShaderPacks: When On, all shader packs are downloaded and cached at startup. When Off, packs are downloaded on demand when needed.
Xaml.WhenOnEachGameGets: When On, each game gets its own screenshot subfolder.
Xaml.WhenOnSwitchesDesktopResolution: When On, switches desktop resolution on game launch and restores on exit.
Xaml.WhenOnSwitchesToThe: When On, switches to the target resolution on game launch and restores it on exit.
Xaml.WhenOnWindowsHdrIs: When On, Windows HDR is automatically enabled when launching a game through RHI and disabled when the game exits.
